architecture.frontend: React 19 (SPA) + Tailwind CSS v4 + Vite 6 + Lucide Icons + Motion
architecture.backend: Node.js + Express 4 + TypeScript (tsx / esbuild) + Vite Middleware
architecture.security: Helmet-grade HTTP Headers, Recursive XSS/Prototype Pollution Sanitizer, Tiered Rate Limiters, Bearer Token RBAC

database.type: In-Memory Database + Synchronous Disk-Backed JSON Persistence

Returns list of all registered users for quick credential selection on login
Returns current session user and full user directory
Switches active viewpoint to audit student or faculty workspace
Fetches users filtered by role, department, or search query
Registers new student or faculty and auto-saves to data/users.json
Updates profile details and auto-saves to disk
Unregisters user and cleans up class enrollment counts
Returns enrolled subjects for student, teaching subjects for faculty, all for admin
Creates a new academic course with credits and syllabus topics
Enrolls students into a course and updates counters
Fetches schedule milestones, lectures, exams, and reference resources
Publishes a new lecture, exam, or practical milestone
Fetches assignments and problem sets for a course
Creates problem set with rubric items and due dates

api_endpoints.auth: Isolated (Student sees self, Teacher sees all)
api_endpoints.description: Fetches assignment submissions
Submits homework solution text or attachment
Grades student submission with points and feedback note
Fetches student personal notes for active subject
Creates or updates markdown note
Deletes student note
Context-aware Socratic AI Tutor with follow-up reflection chips and resources
Multi-modal RAG study assistant with practice questions and YouTube grounding
Deep topic research and verified academic video finder
Summarizes note text into executive digest and key takeaways
Extracts Q&A flashcard study deck from notes
Generates interactive 4-option practice quiz from notes
Generates class performance trends, weak topic alerts, and action items

notes_flow: Desktop/User Input -> SmartNotePlayground.tsx -> POST /api/notes -> inputSanitizerMiddleware (security.ts) -> db.notes in-memory upsert -> Optional AI Summarize/Quiz/Flashcard trigger (gemini.ts) -> Note hydration via GET /api/notes/:subjectId -> UI Render in SmartNotePlayground and ResourceFeed
student_profiles: User entity with role='student', institutionalId, program, academicYear, gpa, status, and enrolledSubjectIds. Managed via AdminDashboard.tsx, persisted in data/users.json, accessed via /api/users and /api/auth/me.
conversations: Turn-by-turn history arrays (StudyChatMessage & ChatMessage). Client-side session state in ChatInterface.jsx and StudyAssistantChat.tsx with invisible context injection (currentSubject, upcomingExam, pendingAssignments) passed to POST /api/tutor and POST /api/ai/chat.
bot_system: Socratic AI Tutor in src/api/tutor/route.js and RAG Study Assistant in src/server/gemini.ts. Enforces no-direct-answer Socratic guardrails, LaTeX mathematical rendering, followUpQuestions prompt chips, and grounding with YouTube videos and textbook chapters from knowledgeBase.ts.
ai_integration_points: Doubt Extraction & Misconception Clustering in class diagnostics (gemini.ts)
External OCR Note Scanning & Batch Ingestion Webhook (/api/notes)
Automated Assignment Grading & Rubric Scoring Helper (/api/submissions/:id/grade)
Personalized Remedial Learning Path Generator in SmartAITutor (ResourceSidebar.jsx)
